roadmap.title: Story and constraint run
roadmap.description: Play the nine sequences in order and complete every optional constraint as you go, reloading the last checkpoint whenever one fails. The story achievements land along the way, and so do My 1st Dressing Chamber, Swamp Queen, Death by Poison, Predator, and Machete. Use the Sequence 3 convoy fight for Poison. Keep trade ships sailing and pickpocket civilians whenever the counter is available to make progress on Thief, and confirm the constraint tracker sits at 100% before leaving the final sequence.

roadmap.title: Side missions and collecting
roadmap.description: Work through the persona side missions (Contracts, The Plot, Detective), Business Rivals, Ship Crew, Free Slaves, and Bayou Fever. Buy all 13 Dressing Chambers, synchronize all 19 viewpoints, and sweep up diary pages, alligator eggs, Mayan statuettes, mushrooms, and the three persona collectible sets. Fund it all with trade ships: buy the seven extra ships and every pocket watch as money allows. Farm Human Shields, Hangman, Umbrella, and Survivor while exploring.

roadmap.title: Citizen E and the true ending
roadmap.description: Kill any remaining Citizen E targets: the Bayou shipwreck, the New Orleans map marker, and the one at the top of Saint Louis Cathedral, plus the two story-locked ones via memory replay if missed. Then finish the Erudito memory for the true ending. If The Truth or Complete 100% of all Mission Constraints glitches, replay the documented memory to force the unlock.

steps.text: Play through the nine memories of @loc{Sequence 1} in New Orleans, ending with the fight at the city exit.
Play the seven memories of @loc{Sequence 2} in the Bayou, ending with the report to @npc{Agaté} at his hideout.
Play through the six memories of @loc{Sequence 4} in New Orleans and Chichen Itza; the escape from the collapsing temple ends the sequence.
Complete @loc{Return to Mexico}, the only memory in @loc{Sequence 6}, and collect the Prophecy Disk piece in the First Civilization sanctum.
Complete the only memory in @loc{Sequence 8}: chase down the sentry in the New York frontier, then kill the fleeing target at the fort.
Finish @loc{Sequence 9} Memory 3, Reconciliation, including the Animus obstacle course at the end.
Climb the three floors of the course and kill the @npc{Citizen E} at the top within 2 minutes.
steps.note: The timer only matters for full synchronization, but the kill is required before the credits resume.

achievements.description: Kill all Citizen E and experience the true ending.
achievements.summary: Kill all 6 Citizen E targets and see the true ending.

guide.context: The @loc{Erudito} memory (Sequence 9 Memory 4) only appears once all six targets are dead. Two are killed in story memories and the other four stay available in free roam after the story, so none can be locked out. The achievement is known to fail to register; replaying Erudito fixes it.

steps.text: Kill the Citizen E revealed by @mechanic{Eagle Vision} right after the Mackandal dies in @loc{Sequence 2 Memory 6}.
In @loc{Chichen Itza}, kill the Citizen E at the top of the temple near the construction site after taking the diary page in @loc{Sequence 4 Memory 5}.
In @loc{New Orleans}, kill the Citizen E at the marked map area during the Sequence 5 cleanup.
In the Bayou, go to the small island south of the north-eastern settlement and kill the citizen inside the beached shipwreck.
Once @loc{Sequence 8} begins, climb @loc{Saint Louis Cathedral} and kill the citizen at the top next to the viewpoint.
Finish the Animus obstacle course in @loc{Sequence 9 Memory 3} and kill the final Citizen E at the top within 2 minutes.
Complete @loc{Erudito}, the final memory, to reach the true ending.
steps.note: Take no damage for full sync; smoke bombs and the pistol make the fight quick. Replay Erudito if the achievement does not unlock.

achievements.summary: Complete every optional constraint in all 9 story sequences for 100% synchronization.

guide.context: Only constraints in the nine story sequences count toward synchronization; side-mission constraints are not required. Each memory is tracked on its own, and reloading the last checkpoint lets you retry a failed constraint without replaying the memory. If 100% does not trigger the achievement, replay a memory such as Father's Troubles in Sequence 1, or complete the post-story memory Connor's Way.

steps.text: Complete every optional constraint shown at the start of each memory; reload the last checkpoint the moment one fails.
Track each sequence in the @mechanic{DNA menu} and replay memories where a constraint was missed; all nine sequences must read 100%.

achievements.description: Block 10 shots or firing lines with a human shield.
achievements.summary: Block 10 shots aimed at you by holding a grabbed guard in front of you.

guide.context: Gunfire is uncommon, so build a large fight: officers with flintlocks shoot more often, and Counter/Throw keeps guards alive to grab.

steps.text: Provoke a crowd of 6 or more guards; 3 or 4 close in while the rest hang back and eventually fire.
When a guard aims at you, grab a nearby guard as a human shield to block the shot; repeat until 10 shots are blocked.
steps.note: Use Counter/Throw instead of kills so enough guards remain as shield material.

achievements.description: Collect all diary pages, alligator eggs, Mayan statuettes, and mushrooms.
achievements.summary: Collect all 30 diary pages and 12 alligator eggs, 10 Mayan statuettes, and 10 mushrooms.

guide.context: Collectibles appear on the map only at close range, and two Mayan statuettes sit inside specific memories.

steps.text: Kill the alligator guarding each nest, then take the alligator egg.
Start the @loc{Bayou Fever} mission with the north-eastern Bayou Witch Doctor so mushrooms appear, then gather all 10.
Sweep New Orleans, the Bayou, and Chichen Itza for the 30 diary pages and 10 Mayan statuettes.
Grab Mayan Statuette #9 in the cenote during @loc{Sequence 4 Memory 6} and Mayan Statuette #10 during @loc{Sequence 6 Memory 1}, Return to Mexico.
steps.note: Either one missed inside its memory means replaying the memory later.

achievements.summary: Collect all 30 persona-specific collectibles: 10 Assassin's Coins, 10 Precious Stones, and 10 Voodoo Dolls.

guide.context: Each persona can only see and take its own collectible type.

steps.text: As the @mechanic{Assassin}, take out the marked targets and loot the Assassin's Coins from their bodies.
As the @mechanic{Lady}, charm the marked gentlemen to receive their Precious Stones; some sit up high and need a ladder to reach.
As the @mechanic{Slave}, pickpocket the marked Houngans for their Voodoo Dolls.

achievements.description: Kill 5 guards in 15 seconds using only the Sugarcane Machete (without using the Chain Kill).
achievements.summary: Kill 5 guards within 15 seconds using only the Sugarcane Machete, with no Chain Kills.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Sugarcane Machete} from a weapon shop if it is not already equipped.
Gather a group of guards, open with a sprinting execution, then counter-kill 5 of them within 15 seconds.
steps.note: Double counters count as two kills. Do not use the Assassin's Chain Kill.

guide.context: Assassinating or shooting alligators outside combat does not count; fight them hand-to-hand.

steps.text: Visit alligator nests, let the alligator attack, and win its struggle prompts; each survived fight counts.
steps.note: Nests respawn, so the same spots can be reused.

achievements.description: Buy the maximum number of ships (8).
achievements.summary: Buy the maximum of 8 trade ships.

guide.context: The number of ships is what counts, not the hull type; keep the fleet sailing to pay for itself.

steps.text: Open the ship menu at the warehouse and buy 7 more ships; seven Galleons cost 25,900 écu.
steps.note: Load each ship with the best-paying local good and send it to the best-paying port to fund the purchases.

achievements.description: Tree Run for 10 branches without touching the ground.
achievements.summary: Tree run across 10 branches without touching the ground.

steps.text: In the Bayou, leap from branch to branch 10 times in a row; hops within a single tree cluster count.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a poison dart.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy using a poison dart.

steps.text: After the @item{Blowpipe} is awarded in @loc{Sequence 2 Memory 2}, equip it and hit a guard with a Fast Poison dart.

guide.context: Full sync is not required for any of these missions.

steps.text: Complete the 5 @item{Contracts} as the Assassin in northern @loc{New Orleans}.
Complete the 5 @loc{The Plot} missions as the Lady in New Orleans.
Complete the 5 @item{Detective} missions as the Slave: 3 in New Orleans and 2 in the Bayou.

achievements.description: Kill 25 enemies with the Parasol Gun.
achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies with the Lady's @item{Parasol Gun}.

guide.context: The Parasol Gun fires poison and berserk poison darts. Only the enemy actually hit counts, so kills made by a berserk target do not.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Parasol Gun} as the Lady and hit enemies with darts in fights around the city.
steps.note: It is awarded at the Assassin's HQ in @loc{Sequence 3 Memory 2}.

steps.text: In @loc{Sequence 1 Memory 7}, buy the marked Dressing Chamber with the money from @npc{Gérald}.

guide.context: Dressing Chambers are only found in New Orleans and the Bayou.

steps.text: Buy the 10 chambers around @loc{New Orleans} from the map icons.
Buy the 3 chambers in the @loc{Bayou}.

achievements.summary: Pickpocket civilians until you have stolen 5,000 écu.

guide.context: The running total is carried across the whole game, so keep stealing as you travel instead of saving it for the end.

steps.text: Pickpocket civilians while traveling, favoring well-dressed targets for larger amounts.
To speed it up: raise Assassin notoriety to full, pay the corrupt official to clear it, then pickpocket him right away; repeat about 6-7 times.

achievements.description: Perform 10 predator moves using the Whip.

guide.context: Only the hanging move counts; grabs and pulls during combat do not.

steps.text: Wait on a horizontal perch, such as a tree branch or wooden beam, for an enemy to pass below.
Grab the enemy with the @item{Whip}, then drop backwards off the perch to hang them; repeat 10 times.

guide.context: Watches unlock at story milestones, and any Smuggler stocks every watch currently available; the final four, including the Parisian Masterpiece, appear late in the game.

steps.text: Buy pocket watches from wandering Smugglers; they roam north of the city east of the cemetery and along the south-eastern harbor.
Keep trade ships earning between story sections and buy each new watch as it unlocks.
steps.note: Prices run from 1,250 écu for the Cartographer's Watch to 43,750 écu for the Admiral's Treasure.

achievements.description: Use berserk poison to force an enemy to kill 5 enemies.
achievements.summary: Force a berserk-poisoned enemy to kill 5 other enemies.

guide.context: The count is not cumulative: one poisoned guard must land all 5 kills before the poison wears off, so reload the last checkpoint and retry.

steps.text: In @loc{Sequence 3 Memory 4}, after the footrace with Élise, approach the guard convoy through the bushes.
Hit the white-jacketed Captain with a berserk dart, then throw a smoke bomb among the other guards so he can cut them down.
steps.note: Reload the checkpoint and try again if the Captain is stopped before 5 kills.

guide.context: The viewpoints are spread across three regions: 11 in New Orleans, 6 in the Bayou, and 2 in Chichen Itza.

steps.text: Climb each viewpoint and synchronize it; use the map icons to track down the ones you have not touched.

guide.context: Any persona can do these missions, and full sync is not required.

steps.text: Clear the 6 Business Rivals missions around @loc{New Orleans}; their target icons appear on the map.
Clear the final Business Rivals mission in the @loc{Bayou} Smugglers' hideout area.

guide.context: All three missions are in New Orleans, and full sync is not required.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Mistress and Commander}: find the trader and take his goods.
Complete @loc{The Cannon}: sneak into the fort and take the cannon blueprints from the second-floor chest in the main barracks without killing anyone.
Complete @loc{Before the Mast}: clear all 11 checkpoints in the race.
steps.note: The race timer is generous. The optional no-damage constraint is threatened by rooftop snipers.

achievements.summary: Complete the Bayou Fever line by curing all 9 infected villagers.

guide.context: Mushrooms only appear once the mission starts; a tenth mushroom exists for the Collector achievement.

steps.text: Speak to the @npc{Witch Doctor} in the north-eastern Bayou settlement, then gather 9 mushrooms before the timer runs out.
Return to him, then cure all 9 marked villagers across the Bayou.
steps.note: The achievement unlocks on the last cure; there is no final mission.

guide.context: The mission markers appear while playing as the Lady; 2 missions are in New Orleans and 1 is in the Bayou.

steps.text: Complete @loc{A Family Divided} outside De Grandpré Mansion and walk the freed slave to safety.
Complete @loc{Earthly Belongings} at the harbor and recover the slave's belongings without killing anyone.
Complete @loc{A New Recruit} in the Bayou and find the missing wife.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy from a tree, with the blowpipe, while using eagle vision.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with the blowpipe from a tree while Eagle Vision is on.

steps.text: Climb a tree above a guard, activate @mechanic{Eagle Vision}, then free-aim a Fast Poison dart down at the guard.
steps.note: Tilted logs above guards also count as a perch.
